# C-4  sealed hierarchies. 11 event roots, 35 permits entries, 40 distinct
#      types. The leaves are not scored: once a root is sealed javac forces its
#      permits list to be its direct-subtype set and forces every one of those
#      to be final, sealed or non-sealed, so a tree that got one wrong does not
#      build. sealed.txt names every root, its kind and its permits.
